deep.reconstruction:
This page contains no mathematics. It is an archival cover sheet (title page) for a folder of notes. It reads: 'Bemerkungen zu der Abhandlung: Über den Zusammenhang zwischen der Theorie der Ideale und der Theorie der höheren Kongruenzen. (Göttingen 1878.)' ('Remarks on the paper: On the connection between the theory of ideals and the theory of higher congruences'). Below the title is '10 Bl.' (10 Blätter, i.e. the folder holds 10 leaves). At the lower left is the archival shelf mark 'IV 13' on a pasted label.

The handwriting, with its rounded Latin cursive and modern spelling 'Kongruenzen', looks like a later archivist's or editor's hand rather than Dedekind's own. That is plausibly from the period when the Nachlass was ordered for the Gesammelte mathematische Werke (Fricke, Noether, Ore, 1930–32), but this is not certain.

The paper referred to is Dedekind's 1878 memoir in the Abhandlungen der Königlichen Gesellschaft der Wissenschaften zu Göttingen, vol. 23. Its contents include:
- the decomposition of a rational prime p in the ring of integers O_K of K = Q(θ) obtained by factoring the minimal polynomial of θ modulo p. This is valid when p does not divide the index [O_K : Z[θ]], and is the Kummer–Dedekind theorem.
- the theorem that p ramifies if and only if p divides the discriminant.
- the discussion of 'common inessential discriminant divisors' (gemeinsame außerwesentliche Diskriminantenteiler).

The 10 leaves that follow, which are not shown here, presumably contain Dedekind's own remarks or additions to that paper. Nothing can be reconstructed from this sheet itself.
deep.surprise_reason: Cover/title sheet only. It identifies a folder of remarks on Dedekind's own well-known 1878 paper, and the page has no mathematical content.
